text: When I passed my final university examinations with high honors.
When my partner proposed to me during our vacation in Paris.
When I was reunited with my family after three years of separation.
When our team won the annual regional football tournament.
When my grandfather passed away after a prolonged illness.
When I realized that my long-term relationship was definitively over.
When I was diagnosed with a chronic health condition.
When I had to say farewell to all my childhood friends before emigrating.
When someone falsely accused me of stealing money from the office.
When a colleague took total credit for the project I completed single-handedly.
When my bicycle was stolen from outside my apartment building.
When an aggressive customer insulted my staff without any justification.
When I was driving on an icy highway and the vehicle suddenly spun out of control.
When I had to undergo an emergency medical operation under general anesthesia.
When I got lost in a dense forest as darkness fell rapidly.
When an armed robbery occurred at the convenience store while I was shopping.
When I found a dead insect inside my soup at an expensive restaurant.
When I witnessed someone spit directly on a public bus seat.
When I smelled the overwhelming odor of rotting garbage on a hot summer day.
When I saw an individual mistreat a defenseless stray animal on the street.
When I opened the front door to find all my distant relatives standing there.
When an unexpected inheritance from a distant great-uncle was announced.
When the weather suddenly changed from clear blue sky to an abrupt thunderstorm.
